name: smwmusic-sonic-the-hedgehog-ms-gg-melodies-of-the-river-bridge-zone-remix
title: Sonic the Hedgehog (MS/GG) - Melodies of the River ~ Bridge Zone (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Bridge Zone from Sonic 1 for the Master System & Game Gear. As much as I love the Genesis Sonic 1 I think I can easily say that I prefer the 8-Bit game way more, and the soundtrack is one of the reasons why.

"𝓢𝓲𝓶𝓹𝓵𝓮 𝔂𝓮𝓽 𝓔𝓵𝓮𝓰𝓪𝓷𝓽."

That perfectly sums up Bridge Zone's theme. It's incredibly short yet doesn't feel repetitive at all. The song has that 90s vibe to it, and the melodies are incredibly catchy. I love Yuzo Koshiro and like always, his work here is legendary.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F Major (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. E Major (Fuller House Pitch)
